verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a productivity and collaboration suite, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of retention policies, retention periods, or data-deletion controls for Workspace content. The nearest items are mobile-device account wipe and listing deleted users. These are adjacent device-management and directory features, not retention or deletion control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
